Based on the image provided, here is the detailed breakdown of the top hero area:

**1) Small Pill/Badge Text**
> **✦ AI-NATIVE PROCESS SIMULATOR**

**2) Big Headline (Exact Text, Line Breaks & Styling)**
The headline uses a large serif font. The first line and the word "live" are **bold/black**, while the middle line is **gray**.

*   **Line 1 (Black/Bold):** Describe any chemical plant.
*   **Line 2 (Gray):** Watch AI engineer it
*   **Line 3 (Black/Bold):** — live.

**3) The Two Buttons**
*   **Button 1 (Primary):**
    *   **Text:** ✦ Build a plant with AI
    *   **Appearance:** Dark gray/black background with white text. Rounded pill shape.
*   **Button 2 (Secondary):**
    *   **Text:** Start at the basics ↓
    *   **Appearance:** White background with a thin light gray border and black text. Rounded pill shape. Includes a down-arrow icon.

**4) Layout Structure**
*   **Yes, it is a 2-column layout.**
    *   **Left Column:** Contains the badge, headline, body copy ("Type a sentence..."), and the two buttons.
    *   **Right Column:** Contains the "AI Plant Builder" demo panel.
*   **Approximate Proportions:** It looks like roughly a **45% / 55% split** or potentially **50/50**, with the right-side demo panel taking up slightly more visual width or being balanced by the whitespace on the left.

**5) Notable Details in the Hero Area**
*   **Demo Panel Header:** "● ○ AI PLANT BUILDER · LIVE LOOP" followed by "2.5s" on the far right.
*   **Demo Panel Content:**
    *   Label: "DESCRIBE YOUR PLANT"
    *   Input text inside box: "Build a 500 t/day methanol plant — natural gas feed.▌" (includes a blinking cursor block).
    *   Status indicators below input:
        *   ◆ ARCHITECT
        *   ◆ ENGINEER
        *   ◆ CRITIC
    *   Console/Status line at bottom left of panel: "▶ reading the brief_"
*   **Body Copy (below headline):** "Type a sentence — any route, any capacity. An architect plans it, an engineer wires every unit and stream, a solver closes the mass and energy balance, and a critic signs it off. Then walk your plant with a narrated, scored tour. No installs — everything runs and solves in your browser."
